discovered.title: Choose your Medisana device
discovered.description: Select your Medisana device. It must be awake and transmitting over Bluetooth.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Medisana device
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name} ({address})? Confirm that this is your Medisana device. Measurements will arrive automatically when the device transmits. Close VitaDock+ and disable any other integration connected to this device.

manual.title: Enter the device address
manual.description: Use this fallback if your device has not been discovered yet. Enter its Bluetooth address from a BLE scan and choose the device type. The device can be asleep during setup. A Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter is required.

scale.title: Choose your scale model
scale.description: Choose the clock format matching your scale before its clock is set and stored measurements are requested. You can change this later in the device options.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_configured: This Medisana device is already configured.
abort.not_supported: No supported Medisana advertisement or active connection path was found.
abort.no_devices_found: No new Medisana devices found. Wake your device, enable its Bluetooth transfer, and try again. You can also enter its Bluetooth address manually.

init.title: Connection, users and history
init.description: User IDs are raw Bluetooth IDs and may differ from the device display. -1 shows all users. Separate user sensors add groups for known IDs (scales: 1–8); guests remain unassigned. History: 0 disables retention and removes existing history; otherwise up to 1000 records are stored locally (default 200). BS A45: try a 3-second connection timeout and 10 attempts if needed. BU 572: optionally enable pairing, time synchronization and clock before notifications. Pairing requires adapter support. Select the appropriate scale clock origin (BS 410/444: 2010; BS 430/440: 1970; variants exist). The connection delay lets composition finish (default 12 seconds).

error.invalid_user_id: Enter a whole number from -1 to 254.
error.invalid_scale_epoch: Choose 1970 or 2010 to match your scale model.
error.invalid_scale_user_id: Enter a whole number from -1 to 8.
error.invalid_connection_delay: Enter a whole number from 0 to 30.
error.invalid_connection_timeout: Enter a whole number from 3 to 60.
error.invalid_connection_attempts: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.
error.invalid_history_limit: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000.

abort.no_options_available: This device has no configurable options.

export_history.name: Export measurement history
export_history.description: Return retained local measurements as CSV. Requires administrator access. Save the csv response as a UTF-8 .csv file.

user_id.name: Bluetooth user ID
user_id.description: Optional. Omit to export all users, including guests.
